v1.0.0 / 2026-10-21

Version 1 baseline

On 21 October 2026, the existing website and accepted knowledge were recorded as v1.0.0 in their own repositories. The tagged files retain their historical 0.1 labels. This designation preserves history; it does not certify the model or announce a new product.

Website v1.0.0↗Framework v1.0.0↗

In development

Next edition · target 1.1.0

This website version is being prepared for publication. The accepted knowledge currently included is identified above. Proposed improvements enter a release after review, acceptance and explicit synchronization.

Planned for the next edition

  • Clearer problem-led introduction and familiar business vocabulary, retaining the hive identity.
  • Preparation for a first case, a worked example and reviewed diagrams and editable resources.
  • Deeper operational guidance on reference practices, AI governance, privacy and implementation choices.
  • Brazilian Portuguese for the revised Portuguese edition, English as default and continued Spanish coverage.

Scope is planned, not delivered. Knowledge enters main after guardian review and passing checks. The website then imports the accepted revision and records the final version pair before publication.
